desc: Get information about a libnet installation
u: libnet-config - Get information about a libnet installation
libnet-config displays information about a previous libnet installation.

<dl><dt data-o="">--cflags</dt><dd>Set of compiler options (CFLAGS) to use when compiling files that use libnet.</dd><dt data-o="">--libs</dt><dd>Shows the complete set of libs and other linker options you will need in order to link your application with libnet.</dd><dt data-o="">--defines</dt><dd>Set of compiler defines used to compile libnet.</dd></dl>

What linker options do I need when I link with libnet?


libnet-config --libs

What compiler options do I need when I compile using libnet functions?


libnet-config --cflags
